section_summary.extract_value: This section details the relationships between trait-based mental toughness and domain mental toughness with various criteria. It reports small, non-significant correlations for trait-based mental toughness and small to moderate positive correlations for domain mental toughness with post-practice self-efficacy, task enjoyment, task knowledge, and performance. The correlation between domain-specific mental toughness and adaptive performance was small and not statistically significant.
